description: ADR 0022, step 2 of 3: the error-code MCP as a Zip Lambda, applianceclinic-error-code-mcp: python3.12, arm64, handler run.sh, 512 MB, 30 s (as spares4repairs-error-code-mcp), role error-code-mcp-role (reused), layer arn:aws:lambda:eu-west-1:753240598075:layer:LambdaAdapterLayerArm64:23 (Lambda Web Adapter 0.8.4, its adapter byte-identical to the image's), code phase8/applianceclinic-error-code-mcp-Wm1i7OG6nSeugc_Cw_AQf6x7VPbGnG2sjd0Ig041sIM.zip (CodeSha256 Wm1i7OG6nSeugc/Cw/AQf6x7VPbGnG2sjd0Ig041sIM=, build/reference/applianceclinic-error-code-mcp.zip.json; built by package_zips.py --mcp-site from build/python/error-code-mcp.lambda-arm64.lock; against the live image only the 16 repaired files of change 18.1 differ, and run.sh is added). Environment: AWS_LAMBDA_EXEC_WRAPPER=/opt/bootstrap, AWS_LWA_PORT=8080, PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, and AC_BEARER_VERSIONS, LEARNING_BUCKET and MCP_BEARER_TOKEN (pinned mcp-bearer reference) as on spares4repairs-error-code-mcp. Its Function URL is auth NONE, BUFFERED, no CORS (bearer-gated in asgi.py, as today), with the two statements a public URL needs: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl with FunctionUrlAuthType NONE, and lambda:InvokeFunction with InvokedViaFunctionUrl. runtime-overrides.json: create.resources ["logs", "alarms", "function"]. Nothing calls it until 22.2. spares4repairs-error-code-mcp, whichpart-api and the engine are not touched.
grantNotes: Creation of the one function, its URL and its two URL statements; read of the one public adapter layer version; PassRole of the reused error-code MCP role only; read of the one staged artefact. The pinned mcp-bearer reference is resolved by the read-only base (ResolveAcBearerReferences).
